findings.note: FR-010 prohibits changing guidance documents, yet all user stories and FR-001–FR-009 define the feature value as guidance content and SC-001–SC-004 assess that content. No allowed delivery artifact is identified, leaving implementation unable to satisfy the acceptance criteria. Clarify the intended deliverable and reconcile it with the no-guidance-change boundary.

The requirement asks for a recorded review outcome but does not define who is authorized to review, which outcomes permit a shared-view change, or what happens after a rejection, conditional outcome, or pending review. As written, recording any outcome could satisfy the requirement without controlling whether the change proceeds.

The trigger stale is not defined by a criterion (for example, superseding source/version or an explicit owner determination). Different authors may therefore disagree on when a gap must be recorded and review requested, weakening consistent testability.
